oracleRisk.summary: Sui describes suiUSDe as an Ethena-powered synthetic dollar backed by digital assets and corresponding short futures positions, but the reviewed public material does not disclose a suiUSDe-specific oracle implementation or failover path.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: suiUSDe has no issuer-side borrower liquidation markets, but Ethena Whitelabel manages a value-sensitive backing allocation for the token, and the announced design values a portfolio of digital assets and corresponding short futures positions. That system-wide valuation and rebalancing authority is scoreable; DeepBook borrower liquidations are third-party consumption, not suiUSDe issuance branches.
